2607.08493.title: Ensemble Diversity Optimization for Subjective Supervision
2607.08493.paper_summary: Subjective NLP tasks often exhibit systematic annotator disagreement, requiring models that represent uncertainty rather than collapse it. We introduce Ensemble Diversity Optimization (EDO), a prediction-space framework that jointly optimizes ensemble weights, effective cardinality, and calibration through a unified differentiable objective. EDO learns ensemble composition and size end-to-end via Gumbel-Softmax relaxation and incorporates a signed diversity regularizer, tuned on validation data, to steer optimization toward either preserving or suppressing disagreement. This regularization prevents ensemble collapse and enables controlled navigation of the utility-calibration trade-off. The framework integrates a soft F1 surrogate, class-weighted cross-entropy to address imbalance, and reliability-weighted diversity to regulate intra-ensemble variability. Experiments on four subjective text-classification benchmarks (ArMIS, ConvAbuse, HS-Brexit, MD-Agreement) show that EDO substantially improves probabilistic calibration, reducing cross-entropy (40-78% depending on baseline) and lowering Brier scores relative to Soft-CE, Soft-MD, Top-5 Voting, and WEL, while maintaining competitive F1 and better alignment with annotator distributions. These results demonstrate that jointly optimizing ensemble structure with a signed diversity regularizer provides an efficient, model-agnostic approach for modeling human subjectivity in supervised learning.
2607.08493.paper_summary_zh: 主觀的自然語言處理任務通常會顯示出系統性的標註者不一致，這需要能夠表示不確定性的模型，而不是將其壓縮。我們介紹了集成多樣性優化（Ensemble Diversity Optimization，EDO），這是一個預測空間框架，通過統一的可微目標共同優化集成權重、有效基數和校準。EDO通過Gumbel-Softmax放鬆端到端學習集成的組成和大小，並結合了一個在驗證數據上調整的簽名多樣性正則化器，以引導優化朝著保留或抑制不一致的方向進行。這種正則化防止了集成崩潰，並使得能夠控制效用與校準之間的權衡。該框架整合了一個軟F1替代品、加權交叉熵以應對不平衡，以及加權多樣性以調節集成內部的變異性。在四個主觀文本分類基準（ArMIS、ConvAbuse、HS-Brexit、MD-Agreement）上的實驗顯示，EDO顯著改善了概率校準，減少了交叉熵（根據基線降低40-78%），並相對於Soft-CE、Soft-MD、Top-5投票和WEL降低了Brier分數，同時保持了競爭力的F1和與標註者分佈的更好對齊。這些結果表明，通過簽名多樣性正則化器共同優化集成結構提供了一種高效的、模型無關的方法來建模監督學習中的人類主觀性。
